PUBLICATION-PROSE-GATE-1 (HARD, 2026-08-18): publication-facing text (abstract, deposited .md, Zenodo metadata description, social posts) MUST be plain scholarly prose for a human reader — internal pipeline vocabulary PROHIBITED (gate names as labels, WBS codes, T1-T8/'seams catalog' shorthand, 'companion artifact', 'research-cycle record', 'Why a reader should care:' as a literal label, ops/data-quality findings).
